column1: # Theorems deleted from the models on purpose, in three groups. First, those
# the audit in formal/audit/unreferenced-theorems.md found nothing referencing
# (no proof in the dump's `uses`, no other declaration naming them, no example,
# docs anchor, claims ledger row, Rust comment, oracle or README mention, and
# no Audit.lean line except `Drain.orderInv_nil`'s, removed with it). Second,
# the rows marked "purpose review", which failed the review recorded in
# reviewed-theorems.tsv (header mentions went with them). Third, the #280
# rows: that unimplemented design model, removed at the owner's request with
# its six Audit.lean lines, its README and header mentions, and the
# definitions only it used (a definition is listed only when nothing left
# mentions it). Fourth, the rows whose reason starts "#N fixed" (#316, #309):
# runs of the Rust before that fix,
# which the fixed model makes false; their Audit.lean lines, README, claims
# ledger and header mentions went with them, and the reason names the
# theorem that states the fixed behaviour. Tab-separated: name, reason, the
# same thing or more (`-` when there is none). Read by
